entities.summary: Thomas Roland Matte, nicknamed "Garbage Can", was an American professional football running back who spent his entire 12-season career with the Baltimore Colts of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football as a quarterback for the Ohio State Buckeyes, and was selected by the Colts in the 1961 NFL draft and by the New York Titans in the 1961 AFL draft.
